decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's established spraying and coating know-how, this product fits its strong absorptive capacity from in-house R&D and research cooperation, so early market learning should favor retention despite only modest website prominence.

A low-pressure injection pump is very close to the firm's core application equipment business, and its dedicated web presence suggests commercial commitment, making withdrawal unlikely for this experienced R&D-active machinery producer.

Because a low-pressure material transfer pump builds on the firm's existing fluid-handling competencies and can be improved through related engineering knowledge, management would be inclined to keep it unless results turn clearly weak.

Although fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, it still builds on the firm's process-system expertise and also matches its move toward more digitalized customer solutions, so the firm is more likely to continue than discontinue it.
